title: extra header names not validated for CR/LF/NUL/colon
description: validation.rs extra_headers loop (line 224) checks extra-header VALUES for CR/LF/NUL but never checks NAMES. A name containing bare CR/LF or colon would corrupt the canonical serialization, producing a structurally ambiguous canonical byte string used for signing. Fix: add a name check in the extra_headers loop: reject names that contain CR, LF, NUL, or colon; cap name length at e.g. 76 bytes.
